text:
Nina Lopez: FYI team -- I put in my resignation today. Last day will be 2026-06-12. @Raj Patel @Samira Gomez can you help with benefits cutoff, exit interview scheduling, and access deprovisioning?

Raj Patel: Thanks for the heads up, Nina. Sorry to see you go. Quick checklist from HR side: PTO payout on final paycheck, benefits through last active day, COBRA election window starts the day after employer coverage ends. I'll book the exit interview.

Nina Lopez: Thanks. Two asks: 1) can I keep read-only access to calendar invites for customer meetings for the next 30 days? 2) need to confirm laptop return logistics.

Samira Gomez: For calendar we can do a shared delegate or keep your calendar visible for 30 days. Need manager sign-off though. I'll ping Raj to confirm.

it-ops: Re devices: We'll create ticket IT-#78642 to schedule pickup or provide return label. Default is drop-off within 7 days of last day. Please wipe nothing; IT will image on receipt. Access deprovision schedule: SSO & prod keys disabled on 2026-06-12 18:00 PT; non-prod accounts removed 2026-06-13 09:00 PT. If you need short-term exceptions (read-only calendar, docs), request via the "limited-access" workflow before your last day.

people-ops-bot: Nina, please complete the resignation form: https://redwoodhr.company/resignations (deadline 48 hours). HR will trigger final payroll calc after submission.

Raj Patel: Confirming benefits timeline: active through 2026-06-12. COBRA election notice mailed electronically by 2026-06-13; you will have 60 days to elect. PTO payout calculated on final payroll (includes accrued vacation, excludes sick per policy). Any open bonus eligibility will be reviewed by Rewards.

Nina Lopez: Noted. For the exit interview, morning slots are better. I'm available 2026-06-10 or 2026-06-11. Also, I have an outstanding corporate phone and a YubiKey.

Samira Gomez: We'll reserve 2026-06-10 10:00 for exit interview with People Ops (can move if needed). Please list outstanding assets in the resignation form. For YubiKey, IT needs it back to remove MFA from your account.

Nina Lopez: Ok added assets in the form. Also FYI -- two customer escalations in my queue: CUST-4123 (pending docs) and CUST-4180 (follow-up scheduled). I've assigned temporary owners in the project board.

Raj Patel: Good handoff. Please also add a quick note about any recurring invoices or vendor logins you manage. We'll rotate those.

it-ops: Adding note: if you require calendar read-only after deprovision, request ticket with manager approval and include start/end dates. We'll restrict to Free/Busy + event titles only.

people-ops-bot: COBRA notice will be sent to the personal email on file. To change it, update here: https://redwoodhr.company/contact-preferences before 2026-06-10.

Nina Lopez: I'll update that. One small ask: can I keep read-only access to the engineering-runbook repo for 2 weeks post-termination to help with knowledge transfer?

Samira Gomez: That's a reasonable ask. Raj can you approve limited repo access for 14 days? If approved, IT will apply read-only perms and audit access.

Raj Patel: Approving 14-day read-only access to specified repo paths. Nina, DM me the exact repo paths and we will kick off the limited-access request.

Nina Lopez: DM sent with paths and exceptions. Thanks everyone.

people-ops-bot: Reminder: final paycheck will be processed on the next scheduled payroll after last day. Check payroll schedule: https://redwoodhr.company/payroll-dates.

Samira Gomez: Closing notes: LOA/resignation checklist for Nina: submit resignation form, confirm assets and shipping, schedule exit interview, sign any NDAs if required, confirm final payroll & PTO, review COBRA packet when received. We'll do a short re-onboarding check if rehired. :heart:

Nina Lopez: Appreciate all the help. Will follow up on the items and confirm the return shipping address for the laptop. :pray:
